name: Creepy Puppeteer — that creature's base power and toughness become 4/3
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. Same wording gap as Mirkwood Meditator, with 'that creature' as the subject: the user points the fired ability at the other attacker. Bears become 4/3; the Puppeteer keeps its printed P/T.

call: if you attacked with exactly one other creature this combat, you may have that creature's base power and toughness become 4/3 until end of turn.
Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with exactly one other creature this combat, you may have that creature's base power and toughness become 4/3 until end of turn.
